answer: Quarantine newcomers on small islands: every fresh identity starts in a bounded sub-economy where it can trade with only a handful of peers and move tiny amounts. To earn a bridge to the mainland it must show a positive delta between the value it creates and the value it extracts, measured over many epochs. Attackers can mint a thousand names, but each island is ferrous: it attracts only real, repeated interaction, and empty accounts rust away with no bridge. One honest agent crosses quickly; a farm of fakes stays stranded.
